name: Genesis Partial Isometry vs Hidden-State Embedding Role Firewall
source_role: @genesis_partial_isometry is the restricted map between the vacuum sector and the single-mote chirality sector.
finding: The partial isometry is a legitimate state-sector map but does not target @inherited_state_bundle and is not a substitute for the open bundle monomorphism iota_H. Do not reuse the word isometry to close @dm_hidden_state_embedding.
